standard_prerequisites.name: Sheaf rule for Hom presheaves
standard_prerequisites.use: V |-> Hom(K|_{f^{-1}V}, K'|_{f^{-1}V}) is a sheaf.

core_obligations: Construct the continuous map f : X -> Y (Topology, Lemma create-map-from-subcollection) and set O_Y = f_*O_X, so that K, K' and B satisfy the hypotheses of vanishing-and-glueing part (2) (proof lines 11201-11209).

The rule V |-> Hom(K|_{f^{-1}V}, K'|_{f^{-1}V}) is a sheaf on Y; the maps (rho'_U)^{-1} o rho_U : K|_U -> K'|_U agree on overlaps, hence give a unique global section defining the isomorphism K -> K' compatible with all structure; the negative exts of K vanish by the same lemma (proof lines 11210-11221).
proof_roadmap: Transport the system along the continuous map.
Glue the local isomorphisms through the sheaf of Homs.
difficulty_reason: The proof transports the system along the continuous map from the Topology lemma, uses the sheaf rule from vanishing-and-glueing (2), and glues the local isomorphisms rho'^{-1}rho through a unique global section of a sheaf of Hom sets.
